description: Edits the user sent from the layout-debug window that no agent has taken yet: comment + element facts + drag measurements. Each edit starts with its requestId. In listen mode use wait_for_message instead. Once you have handled an edit, report back via reply_in_window with that requestId: the user is watching the window, and the id marks that edit as done there.

markConsumed.description: Mark the returned edits as read
